newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal buys 100 buses from Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Senegal buys 100 buses from Algeria.

text.p: Senegal's public transport company SOTRAC, which has been earmarked for privatisation, has taken delivery of 100 buses bought from Algerian manufacturer SNVI, officials said on Monday.
An order is also planned with Sweden's Volvo and India's Tata Engineering Locomotive Co Ltd, they said.
"We have other purchasing projects with the Swedish cooperation, Volvo and with India through the firm Tata," SOTRAC's general manager Elhadji Malick Niang told reporters.
Senegal purchased 100 buses worth $13.22 million with financing from the Islamic Development Bank.
Commuters in the Senegalese capital have been facing acute problems, and authorities decided to privatise public transport to improve services.
